name: Aparthotel Buchauer.Tirol
beschreibung: The Aparthotel Buchauer.Tirol provides high-standard hotel accommodation situated in the picturesque setting of Thiersee. The property features comfortable apartments with a modern kitchenette and a living area. A generous breakfast buffet highlights exquisite regional delicacies. An inviting wellness area featuring a relaxing sauna complements the amenities. Its peaceful location on the outskirts of the village opens up panorama views of the mountain scenery. Well-marked hiking and cycling paths traverse the surrounding area, and premier winter sports facilities are located nearby. The concept seamlessly combines self-contained independence with hotel convenience, perfect for guests seeking superior flexibility.
